product_overview: This backend slice implements the Identity onboarding flow for new users: registration, email verification, login, and password recovery. It uses JWT session cookies and a lightweight email-code workflow, while broader Organization and tenancy features remain out of scope for this phase.
core_goals: Allow visitors to register accounts with basic identity fields and secure password hashing
Verify newly registered users through a one-time email code before activation
Authenticate active users with JWT issued in an httpOnly cookie
Support password reset via emailed one-time code
Provide a service health endpoint for infrastructure readiness checks

features.name: Health check
features.description: Provides a lightweight liveness endpoint to confirm the API and its dependencies are wired correctly.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with service status indicating the API is healthy
GET /health during a degraded or unavailable startup state -> Receive non-200 or unhealthy status response

features.name: User registration
features.description: Allows a visitor to create a new account using full name, email, phone, and password. The password is hashed and the account starts in an EmailUnverified state.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid fullName, email, phone, and password -> Receive 201 with userId and email
POST /api/auth/register with missing or invalid fields -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 409 conflict for duplicate email

features.name: Email verification
features.description: Lets a newly registered user request a one-time 6-digit verification code and then confirm their email address to activate the account.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/request-verification-code with a registered email -> Receive 200 confirmation message -> Code is logged by the stub email sender -> POST /api/auth/verify-email with the email and valid 6-digit code -> Receive 200 and account becomes Active
POST /api/auth/request-verification-code with an unknown email -> Receive 404 no account found
POST /api/auth/verify-email with an invalid, expired, or already-used code -> Receive 400 verification failure
POST /api/auth/verify-email with an unknown email -> Receive 404 no account found

features.name: Login and session management
features.description: Authenticates active users with email and password, issues a JWT in an httpOnly session cookie, exposes the current user, and supports logout.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with verified email and correct password -> Receive 200 with userId, email, and fullName -> erp_auth cookie is set -> GET /api/auth/me with the cookie -> Receive 200 with current user id and email
POST /api/auth/login with an unverified account -> Receive 403 email not verified yet
POST /api/auth/login with invalid email or password -> Receive 401 invalid credentials
GET /api/auth/me without the erp_auth cookie -> Receive 401 unauthenticated
POST /api/auth/logout with an active erp_auth cookie -> Receive 200 OK and session cookie is cleared

features.name: Password reset
features.description: Allows a user to request a 6-digit reset code by email and then set a new password using the code.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/forgot-password with a registered email -> Receive 200 confirmation message -> Code is logged by the stub email sender -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with email, valid 6-digit code, and newPassword -> Receive 200 password reset success message
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with an unknown email -> Receive 404 no account found
POST /api/auth/reset-password with an invalid, expired, or already-used code -> Receive 400 password reset failure
POST /api/auth/reset-password with an unknown email -> Receive 404 no account found
POST /api/auth/reset-password with missing or invalid newPassword fields -> Receive 400 validation error

tech_stack: JWT (System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt), issued as an httpOnly cookie

features.name: Health check
features.description: Liveness endpoint proving DI/MediatR/EF Core are wired.

features.name: User registration
features.description: Registers a new user with Full Name, Email, Phone, Password; hashes the password and creates the account with status EmailUnverified. Rejects duplicate emails.

endpoints.description: Create a new user account (status starts as EmailUnverified)

body.email: string (required, valid email, max 256 chars, must be unique)

features.name: Email verification
features.description: Issues and validates a 6-digit, 15-minute-lived one-time code used to activate a newly registered account. Code delivery is stubbed to a log-to-console email sender.

endpoints.description: Issues a new 6-digit email verification code for the given account and logs it via the stub email sender

response_schema.404: No account found with this email

endpoints.description: Validates the 6-digit code and flips the account's status from EmailUnverified to Active. Idempotent if already Active.

response_schema.400: Invalid, expired, or already-used code / validation error
response_schema.404: No account found with this email

features.name: Login
features.description: Authenticates by email + password and issues a JWT in an httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None cookie (erp_auth). Rejects unverified accounts.

endpoints.description: Verifies credentials and sets the erp_auth session cookie
Returns the current authenticated user's id and email, resolved from the erp_auth cookie's JWT

features.name: Password reset
features.description: Issues a 6-digit, 15-minute-lived password reset code by email, then accepts email + code + new password to update the account's password hash.

endpoints.description: Issues a password reset code for the given account and logs it via the stub email sender

response_schema.404: No account found with this email

endpoints.description: Validates the reset code and sets a new password

response_schema.400: Invalid, expired, or already-used code / validation error
response_schema.404: No account found with this email

known_limitations.issue: No bot-check (CAPTCHA/Turnstile) or Terms-of-Service acceptance on registration
known_limitations.impact: FR-1.1's bot-check/ToS requirement is explicitly deferred as later hardening per the roadmap; not implemented in this slice.

known_limitations.issue: request-verification-code, forgot-password, and reset-password return 404 for an unknown email
known_limitations.impact: Reveals whether an email is registered (user enumeration); acceptable for this pre-production phase, flagged as a production-hardening item.

known_limitations.issue: Organization/Tenancy features (FR-1.3's org list, FR-1.4 org creation wizard, FR-1.5 trial, FR-1.6 invitations, FR-1.7 multi-org switching) are not implemented
known_limitations.impact: Only the Identity-context auth slice (register/verify/login/forgot/reset) exists; anything Organization-related will 404.
